name: RepositoryReviewAgent
description: Deterministic scanner rules over every indexed language (secrets, real-auth detection, tests incl. JS/TS) plus one fenced, location-validated LLM design review; findings sorted by severity, unlocatable LLM findings kept as unverified without scorecard penalty; 0-100 scorecard per dimension.

inputs.name: repo_dir
inputs.description: Checkout used to validate finding locations

inputs.name: repo_model
inputs.description: Routes, models and counts for the review summary

inputs.name: agent_profile
inputs.description: observed_risks from RepoAnalysisAgent, given to the LLM review as hints to verify

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Findings sorted by severity with location, rationale, fix, source, confidence and verified (false = LLM finding that could not be located; not penalised)
